other_conditions: Applicant must be the legal heir/family of the deceased fisherman
Deceased fisherman must have died while fishing
Deceased fisherman must not have been a beneficiary of the old age pension scheme
Deceased fisherman must have been enrolled as a member of the Fishermen/Fisherwomen Co‑operative Society
Application must be made within 30 days of the death
benefits_summary: ₹1,00,000 immediate death relief assistance provided to the family of the deceased fisherman within 15 days to 3 months of application.
documents_required: self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
